description:
Differential testing of `pkix-chain::verify_*` against `openssl verify` for the canonical purposes.

For each purpose:
- **TLS server** — `openssl verify -purpose sslserver -verify_hostname <name>` vs `pkix_chain::verify_tls_server(..., name)`.
- **TLS client** — `-purpose sslclient`.
- **S/MIME signer** — `-purpose smimesign -verify_email <addr>`.
- **Code signing** — `-purpose codesign`.
- **OCSP responder** — `-purpose ocsphelper`.

Test corpus per purpose:
- Boundary cases: wildcard hostnames, IDN, mailbox case-folding, EKU restrictions, etc.
- Sourced from `pkix-difftest` existing corpora (PKITS, x509-limbo where applicable) + curated `pkix-difftest/oracles/openssl/` cases.

Harness: extend `pkix-difftest` to run both oracles per test case and report disagreements.

Acceptance: per-purpose pass-rate documented in `pkix-difftest/baseline-verify-openssl.md`. Disagreements either resolved (one side is wrong, fix it) or documented (legitimate semantic divergence, e.g., OpenSSL legacy behavior we don't replicate).

**Blocks on:** .15 (ergonomic wrappers — the test-side API).
